title: Brakes Squealing or Grinding
symptoms: high pitched squeal when slowing down
harsh grinding noise when pressing the brake
brakes sound like metal scraping together
intermittent squeak coming from the wheels that changes with braking
possible_causes: worn brake friction pads
grit or road debris caught in the brake assembly
corrosion or scoring on the brake discs
recommended_checks: safely bring the vehicle to a stop and avoid driving if a harsh grinding sound is present
check through the wheel spokes visually to see if brake discs have visible scoring
have the braking system thoroughly inspected by a qualified mechanic

title: Soft or Spongy Brake Pedal
symptoms: brake pedal goes almost all the way to the floor
pedal feels mushy rather than firm underfoot
car takes noticeably longer to slow down when stepping on the brakes
having to pump the brake pedal to get stopping power
possible_causes: air trapped within the hydraulic brake lines
low brake fluid level
internal leak or failure in the brake master cylinder
recommended_checks: stop the vehicle safely in a secure location and discontinue driving immediately
visually check the brake fluid reservoir level under the bonnet if safe to do so
have the vehicle inspected and recovered by a qualified mechanic before driving

title: ABS Warning Light On
symptoms: amber ABS icon stays illuminated on the dashboard
anti-lock braking light popped up while driving
yellow warning symbol with ABS lettering lit on the dash cluster
intermittent flash of the ABS lamp when starting the car
possible_causes: faulty or soiled wheel speed sensor
low brake fluid level in the reservoir
malfunction within the anti-lock brake control module
recommended_checks: pull over safely to confirm whether the primary red brake warning light is also illuminated
check the brake fluid reservoir level under the bonnet visually
have the anti-lock braking system scanned and inspected by a qualified mechanic

title: Car Pulling to One Side When Braking
symptoms: car swerves towards the kerb when stepping on the brakes
steering wheel tugs to the left or right when slowing down
vehicle darts off course during firm braking
feeling a distinct sideways pull each time the brake is pressed
possible_causes: sticking or seized brake caliper on one side
uneven wear across the brake pads or discs
hydraulic fluid restriction or contamination affecting one wheel
recommended_checks: safely bring the vehicle to a stop and do not continue driving if the pull is severe
check safely from outside for excessive heat or a burning smell coming from any wheel
have the brake assemblies and suspension inspected by a qualified mechanic

title: Low or Uneven Tyre Pressure
symptoms: tyre pressure warning light illuminated on the dashboard
one tyre looks visibly flatter or bulges at the bottom
car feels heavier and slower to roll forward
faint rumbling sound coming from one of the tyres while driving
possible_causes: puncture caused by a nail or sharp road debris
slow leak around the valve stem or wheel rim bead
natural pressure loss due to significant ambient temperature changes
recommended_checks: park the vehicle safely on flat, level ground away from moving traffic
visually inspect all four tyres for obvious deflation, bulges, or embedded objects
check and adjust pressures using a tyre gauge at a nearby service station

title: Steering Wheel Vibrating at Speed
symptoms: steering wheel shakes when driving on the motorway
noticeable wobble through the steering wheel between 50 and 70 mph
hands feel a buzzing vibration through the wheel at higher speeds
front of the car feels unsettled and trembles at speed but calms down when slowing
possible_causes: unbalanced front road wheels
uneven tyre wear, flat spots, or tyre deformation
slightly bent wheel rim from a pothole impact
recommended_checks: safely reduce road speed to check if the vibration lessens
inspect front wheels visually for missing balance weights or visible tyre deformities
have the wheels balanced and alignment checked by a qualified tyre technician

title: Car Drifting or Pulling While Driving
symptoms: car constantly wanders towards the edge of the road
having to hold the steering wheel slightly turned to go straight
car drifts to one side as soon as the wheel is released on a flat road
feeling like the car is fighting you to stay centered in the lane
possible_causes: misaligned wheel tracking
uneven tyre pressures across the front axle
worn suspension bushes or steering ball joints
recommended_checks: check that all tyres are inflated to their recommended pressures
inspect the front tyre tread visually for uneven wear on the inner or outer edges
have wheel tracking and suspension geometry inspected by a qualified technician

title: Heavy Steering or Whining Noise When Turning
symptoms: steering wheel feels extremely stiff and difficult to turn
loud whining or groaning sound when turning corners
struggling to turn the wheel while trying to park
steering assist feels jerky or cuts out mid-turn
possible_causes: low hydraulic power steering fluid level
failing power steering pump or electric assist motor
loose or slipping auxiliary drive belt
recommended_checks: bring the vehicle to a safe stop as compromised steering poses a serious driving hazard
visually check the power steering fluid reservoir if the vehicle uses hydraulic assist
have the steering system and drive belt inspected by a qualified mechanic

title: Engine Misfire or Rough Idle
symptoms: car shudders and shakes while waiting at traffic lights
engine sounds uneven and chugs when idling
car feels jerky or hesitates during light acceleration
exhaust note sounds lumpy or makes faint popping noises
possible_causes: worn or fouled spark plugs
failing ignition coil pack
partially clogged fuel injector or vacuum line leak
recommended_checks: check if the check engine light is flashing, which indicates you should pull over safely
listen carefully for irregular sputtering from the exhaust while parked safely
have the engine diagnostic codes and ignition components inspected by a qualified mechanic

title: Check Engine Light On
symptoms: amber engine outline light lit up on the instrument cluster
check engine warning appeared unexpectedly while driving
yellow motor icon stays on continuously after starting
dashboard screen displays an engine management warning message
possible_causes: loose, damaged, or improperly fitted fuel filler cap
faulty oxygen sensor or exhaust emissions sensor
reduced efficiency in the catalytic converter system
recommended_checks: confirm whether the light is steady or flashing; a flashing light requires stopping safely immediately
check that the fuel cap is securely closed and fully clicked into place
have the stored computer diagnostic codes read and inspected by a qualified mechanic

title: Engine Stalling
symptoms: engine cuts out completely when slowing down to a junction
car dies without warning while waiting at lights
revs drop suddenly and the motor cuts off while driving
engine turns off just after starting up
possible_causes: dirty or malfunctioning idle air control or throttle body
failing crankshaft or camshaft position sensor
inadequate fuel delivery from a weak fuel pump or blocked filter
recommended_checks: safely guide the vehicle off the carriageway, stop safely, and turn on hazard warning lights
check the instrument panel for warning indicators such as battery or engine lights
have the fuel delivery and engine management systems inspected by a qualified mechanic

title: Loss of Power or Sluggish Acceleration
symptoms: car accelerates very slowly when putting your foot down
engine feels flat and struggles when trying to climb hills
car seems restricted in speed and will not rev freely
pedal is pressed but the vehicle barely picks up speed
possible_causes: clogged engine air filter or fuel filter
turbocharger boost loss or split intercooler hose
restricted exhaust flow from a blocked catalytic converter
recommended_checks: safely stay in the slower lane or pull over if unable to maintain normal traffic flow
check visually under the bonnet for any disconnected or split air intake hoses
have the powertrain and boost system inspected by a qualified mechanic

title: Burning Smell from the Car
symptoms: strong burning rubber or plastic smell inside the cabin
acrid chemical odour coming through the heating vents
oily burning smell noticeable when stepping out of the car
sharp burnt toast or clutch smell after driving up a hill
possible_causes: engine oil leaking onto a hot exhaust component
overheated friction material from a sticking brake caliper
slipping clutch assembly or melting electrical wire insulation
recommended_checks: stop the vehicle safely immediately, switch off the engine, and exit safely
inspect visually from a safe distance for any visible smoke, heat haze, or flames
have the vehicle examined and towed for inspection by a qualified mechanic

title: Car Won't Start, Only Clicking
symptoms: rapid clicking noise when turning the ignition key
single loud click under the bonnet but the engine does not turn over
dashboard lights flicker and click when attempting to start
car makes a clicking sound but the motor will not crank at all
possible_causes: depleted or severely discharged starting battery
loose or corroded battery cable connections
failing starter motor solenoid contact
recommended_checks: check that the battery terminal clamps are tightly secured and free of white powdery corrosion
observe if the interior or dashboard lights dim severely when the starter clicks
have the battery and starter circuit inspected by a qualified breakdown technician

title: Car Cranks but Won't Start
symptoms: engine turns over normally but never actually fires up
starter spins the engine continuously without catching
car sounds like it wants to start but keeps cranking fruitlessly
engine coughs slightly while cranking but refuses to run
possible_causes: fuel delivery failure such as a faulty fuel pump or empty tank
ignition failure resulting in lack of electrical spark
faulty crankshaft sensor preventing the engine from timing ignition and fuel
recommended_checks: check the dashboard fuel gauge to ensure the fuel tank is not empty
listen for a brief faint humming sound from the fuel pump when turning the ignition to on
have the fuel, ignition, and sensor systems inspected by a qualified mechanic

title: Charging or Alternator Warning Light
symptoms: battery symbol lit up in red on the dashboard while driving
red battery icon glowing steadily after the engine starts
warning message saying charging system failure
dashboard lights briefly flickering alongside the battery symbol
possible_causes: failing alternator output
broken or slipping auxiliary drive belt
internal alternator voltage regulator malfunction
recommended_checks: safely pull over and turn off non-essential electrical items like air conditioning or heated seats
visually inspect the engine bay for a snapped drive belt if safe to do so
have the charging system and alternator tested by a qualified mechanic

title: Dim or Flickering Headlights
symptoms: headlights dim noticeably when slowing down to a stop
headlights pulsating or flickering while driving at night
beams brightening visibly when stepping on the accelerator
headlights appear much dimmer than usual on the road
possible_causes: weakening alternator electrical supply
loose or corroded battery terminal connections
failing headlight bulbs or poor electrical earthing
recommended_checks: safely pull over and observe whether headlights brighten when gently raising engine revs in neutral
check battery connections visually for loose clamps or corrosion
have the electrical and charging circuit inspected by a qualified technician

title: White Smoke from the Exhaust
symptoms: thick billows of sweet-smelling white smoke from the exhaust pipe
clouds of white steam pouring from the back even after the engine is warm
dense white exhaust smoke that lingers in the air behind the car
white smoke coming from the tailpipe alongside an engine temperature rise
possible_causes: blown cylinder head gasket allowing coolant into combustion chambers
cracked engine block or cylinder head
internal engine coolant leakage
recommended_checks: safely stop the vehicle and turn off the engine to prevent severe overheating or engine damage
check the coolant expansion tank level visually once the engine is completely cold
have the engine tested and inspected by a qualified mechanic

title: Blue Smoke from the Exhaust
symptoms: bluish-grey smoke puffing from the tailpipe when pulling away
cloud of blue smoke on startup after the car has been parked
continuous blue haze trailing behind the car while accelerating
noticeable burnt oil smell coming from the exhaust
possible_causes: worn valve stem oil seals
worn or sticking piston rings
leaking internal turbocharger oil seals
recommended_checks: check the engine oil level with the dipstick on level ground when the engine is cold
monitor oil consumption closely to ensure the oil level does not drop dangerously low
have the engine and turbocharger inspected by a qualified mechanic

title: Black Smoke from the Exhaust
symptoms: dark black soot and smoke billowing from the exhaust under load
black exhaust clouds when stepping hard on the accelerator
soot accumulating around the rear bumper and tailpipe
dark smoke from the back accompanied by a strong petrol or diesel smell
possible_causes: severely clogged engine air filter
leaking or stuck-open fuel injector
faulty mass airflow sensor causing an over-rich fuel mixture
recommended_checks: visually check the engine air filter housing for heavy contamination or blockages
check for any warning lights such as the check engine light on the dashboard
have the fuel injection and air intake systems inspected by a qualified mechanic

title: Coolant Leak or Sweet Smell
symptoms: puddle of bright pink, blue, or green liquid under the front of the car
sweet syrupy smell inside the car when using the heater
sweet sugary odour coming from under the bonnet after a drive
coolant reservoir level dropping noticeably over a few days
possible_causes: leaking radiator or degraded coolant hose
failing water pump seal
leaking heater matrix inside the dashboard assembly
recommended_checks: safely stop the car and shut off the engine if temperature begins to climb to avoid severe overheating
visually inspect underneath the front of the vehicle for drips or coloured coolant pooling
have the cooling system pressure-tested and inspected by a qualified mechanic

title: Oil Leak Under the Car
symptoms: dark brown or black slippery puddle on the driveway
fresh wet oil drips on the ground where the car was parked
oily film and grime covering the underside of the engine
oil level on the dipstick dropping steadily between drives
possible_causes: deteriorated engine sump plug washer or loose drain bolt
worn valve cover gasket or oil pan gasket
failing crankshaft or camshaft oil seal
recommended_checks: safely stop the vehicle and do not drive if the oil level drops below minimum to avoid loss of oil pressure
check the engine oil dipstick level safely when parked on flat ground
have the source of the oil leak inspected and repaired by a qualified mechanic

title: Smell of Fuel
symptoms: strong raw petrol or diesel odour inside the car cabin
persistent smell of raw fuel when walking up to the car
strong fuel fumes coming through the ventilation vents while idling
smell of unburnt fuel lingering around the vehicle after parking
possible_causes: leaking fuel line, hose, or fitting
loose, cracked, or missing fuel filler cap or neck seal
leaking fuel injector seal or fuel rail connection
recommended_checks: safely stop the vehicle in an open, well-ventilated area, turn off the engine immediately, and do not smoke
check visually under the vehicle for dripping liquid fuel without using open flames or sparks
have the fuel system thoroughly inspected by a qualified mechanic before driving again

title: Automatic Gearbox Jerking or Slipping
symptoms: harsh clunk or jolt when the car shifts gears
engine revs jump up before the transmission engages
gearbox hesitates or delays before changing gear
car feels like it slips out of gear momentarily when accelerating
possible_causes: low or degraded transmission fluid
worn internal transmission friction clutches
faulty transmission shift solenoid or valve body
recommended_checks: check the transmission fluid level using the dipstick if the vehicle provides one
visually inspect underneath the gearbox area for reddish or dark transmission fluid leaks
have the automatic transmission diagnosed and inspected by a qualified mechanic

title: Clutch Slipping or Hard to Press
symptoms: engine revs rise when pressing the gas but the car barely accelerates
clutch pedal feels unusually heavy and stiff to push down
clutch bites right at the very top of the pedal travel
burning friction smell when pulling away on a hill
possible_causes: worn clutch friction plate
failing clutch pressure plate or release bearing
binding clutch master or slave hydraulic cylinder
recommended_checks: safely pull over if the clutch fails to engage or disengage properly
check clutch hydraulic fluid level in the reservoir under the bonnet if fitted
have the clutch assembly and hydraulic linkage inspected by a qualified mechanic

title: Squealing Noise from the Engine Belt
symptoms: piercing screech from under the bonnet on cold morning startups
loud squeal that worsens when turning the steering wheel or switching on AC
shrill squeaking noise that speeds up with engine revs
intermittent loud squeak coming from the front of the engine
possible_causes: worn, glazed, or cracked serpentine drive belt
slack belt tension caused by a weak automatic tensioner
misaligned or seizing accessory pulley bearing
recommended_checks: visually inspect the accessory drive belt for visible fraying, cracks, or glazing when the engine is off
listen to identify whether the noise increases when switching on electrical loads or air conditioning
have the belt tension and drive pulleys inspected by a qualified mechanic

title: Knocking Noise Over Bumps
symptoms: dull thud or clunking noise when driving over speed bumps
rattling or knocking from the wheel arch on rough roads
hollow metallic knock when going over potholes
clunk sound from underneath when driving over uneven road surfaces
possible_causes: worn suspension anti-roll bar drop links or bushes
worn lower ball joint or control arm bush
failing shock absorber strut or top mount bearing
recommended_checks: safely reduce speed over uneven road surfaces to minimise vehicle instability
visually inspect wheel arches and suspension springs for cracks or loose hardware if visible
have the suspension and steering joints inspected by a qualified technician

title: Humming or Roaring from a Wheel
symptoms: deep humming or droning sound that gets louder the faster you drive
roaring noise like an aeroplane taking off coming from one side
wheel noise that changes tone or pitch when gently swerving or cornering
grumbling vibration felt through the car floor at motorway speeds
possible_causes: worn or failing wheel hub bearing
severely uneven or cupped tyre tread wear
debris caught between the brake dust shield and the wheel assembly
recommended_checks: pay attention to whether the humming noise shifts louder when turning gently left or right
visually inspect tyre tread for uneven scallop-shaped wear patterns
have the wheel bearings and hub assemblies inspected by a qualified mechanic

title: Poor Fuel Economy
symptoms: car using significantly more petrol or diesel than normal
fuel gauge dropping much faster on everyday journeys
trip computer reporting a noticeable drop in miles per gallon
having to fill up the fuel tank much more frequently
possible_causes: under-inflated tyres causing higher rolling resistance
faulty engine coolant temperature sensor or oxygen sensor
clogged air filter or binding brake caliper causing drag
recommended_checks: check that all four tyres are inflated to their recommended pressures
check if any wheel rim feels unusually warm after driving, which could indicate brake drag
have the engine management and emissions sensors scanned by a qualified mechanic

title: Air Conditioning Not Blowing Cold
symptoms: air from the dashboard vents stays lukewarm when AC is switched on
air conditioning blows warm air even on the coldest temperature setting
faint hissing sound behind the dashboard when activating air con
cabin takes a very long time to cool down on a warm day
possible_causes: low refrigerant gas level caused by a minor system leak
failing air conditioning compressor or clutch not engaging
clogged cabin pollen filter or blocked air con condenser
recommended_checks: check that the cabin pollen filter is not clogged with leaves or dust
visually check the front AC condenser through the front grille for bent fins or road debris
have the refrigerant pressure and air conditioning system inspected by a qualified technician
